description: GET /v1/merchants/me/balance/charges - what the prepaid balance was charged for, newest first: one row per sponsored operation or platform action with its chain, gas cost, markup, billed amount and status (a row still waiting for a price carries no billed amount). Test returns informational estimates, never money. Amounts are USD microdollars (x 10^6) as decimal strings. Pass nextCursor back as cursor for the next page. Requires mode unless exactly one key mode is cached. Uses the cached sk_* key of that mode, else a fresh JWT. Read-only.
name: paymaster_balance_charges_list
title: List gas charges or Test cost estimates
